name: RAOfflineProxy
summary: Provides an offline RetroAchievements proxy for supported emulators.

notes: User-approved for review, but blocked: the Knulli asset is a self-extracting shell installer instead of a supported ZIP or tar.gz archive.
The built-in updater downloads and executes a selected shell asset without checksum verification. It cannot bypass App Store transactions.

The GitHub asset is 510188 bytes with API digest cd3e8b2eb891751b7f80463e9cbcc5b9065668d26a20c14acf2d8f63191fcda3, but exact extracted size, complete writes, dependency ABI, and device evidence remain unresolved.

evidence.note: Alpha release observed during review. GitHub reports the release as mutable; it is not approved for installation.
